title: Equil 5.4 battery and control issue
symptom: After pairing the Equil pump with AAPS, bolus worked but battery showed 0% with warnings. After changing the battery, the pump stopped responding to commands, couldn't set up piston, unpair, or bolus. After restarting phone, could pair again and bolus, but battery still 0%. A bolus of 0.07 (clamped to 0.05) failed on progress screen, and subsequent boluses were impossible.
cause: The thread indicates the user's pump firmware version is too low; the maintainer states 'you need firmware at least 5.3' and later clarifies the user meant version 5.4, implying the firmware version is the cause of the issues.
fix: The maintainer states that the battery report issue is fixed in a specific commit and in dev3. The user should update to a firmware version at least 5.3 (or 5.4) and use the fixed AAPS version.
